description: Search the assets Gale Finance covers by ticker or name and list, for each, its asset page and the published pair comparisons, calendar-year pages, and long-term scorecards. Omit query to page through all coverage. Example: "Do you cover Hyperliquid?".

asset_type.description: Filter by asset type: crypto, stock, etf, commodity, stablecoin, or index

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous find_assets call with the same query

query.description: Ticker or name, e.g. "HYPE" or "gold". Omit to list everything

name: find_assets

data_through.description: Data-through date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the cited figures

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; only valid for this snapshot and query

compare_years.description: Calendar years with a published compare page (use compare_assets horizon)

source_url.description: Canonical Gale page holding these figures

title: Find assets Gale covers
